exercices.subject: Anglais B
exercices.text:
Homework
Task 1:Write five sentences that reveal a character's traits implicitly (indirect characterization) using each element of the STEAL acronym: Speech, Thoughts, Effect on others, Actions, and Looks.



Task 2: Find on toddle an extract from chapter two of  Things Fall Apart (extract A1), read the passage, and analyse how the author used indirect characterisation to convey important messages.



Task 3: For the next class, do research on different types of characters based on their complexity and how they change over time.
